I confirm also that I still see the issue with MetaTrait test failures in
1.03. Unlike the previous commentator, I am not seeing a segmentation
fault or core dump.

My system is fairly new and so I am interested in whether this issue is
just some sort of system configuration / environment problem on my machine
or is an issue with STAN. If there is any additional information or
testing I can provide, I would certainly like to help out.

Thanks again.

tests
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=72

These test failures seem to happen on many recent Linux distributions, but
not Mac or Windows. When they fail, they fail on both g++ and clang++, so
it is likely an issue of how the underlying C++ library works on Linux.
